image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming against a textured, rocky coral reef background. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body/head and yellow posterior body. The image has a soft, painterly quality typical of AI generation or heavy filtering.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the general black/yellow split is present, the 'black margin' on the tail is missing or extremely faint. The transition between black and yellow is somewhat muddy/blended rather than sharp. The yellow is more lemon-yellow than deep gold.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal fin is represented as a solid black triangular shape fused into the back. There is no visual distinction between spiny and soft-rayed portions; it lacks individual rays or texture, appearing as a flat painted region.
The anal fin is barely distinguishable from the body contour. It lacks the defined shape and ray structure described in the taxonomy.
The caudal fin (tail) is visible and has a generally rounded outline, though the edges are soft.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin lacks scales or realistic texture, appearing smooth and plastic-like with airbrushed gradients. This is a common AI artifact where fine biological details are smoothed out.

The fins are not distinct appendages with rays but rather colored regions merged into the body mass. The dorsal fin lacks structural integrity, appearing as a flat triangle rather than a flexible fin membrane.

There is an unnatural uniformity to the blur. The background rocks have a repetitive, noisy texture that doesn't follow natural depth-of-field rules, suggesting generative noise rather than optical blur.
The pectoral fin (side fin) is indistinct and seems to merge seamlessly into the black/yellow boundary without a clear joint or separation, looking like a smudge rather than a limb.
